Container.Name: filearr-postgres
Container.Overview:
PostgreSQL 18 for filearr — source of truth for the catalog AND the job queue (Procrastinate). Pinned to 18.4 (fixes 11 CVEs vs 18.0). Uses PG18's native uuidv7() and async I/O (io_method=worker, set via Post Arguments).
Install this container FIRST.
NETWORKING: two topologies are supported and you should pick one before installing anything. DEFAULT — every container on one user-defined Docker network, addressing each other by NAME; create it once with docker network create filearr and leave the DSNs as shipped. ALTERNATIVE — every container fully bridged (Network Type: Custom br0) with its own fixed LAN IP, and IPs in place of names in every DSN. Both are documented field by field: https://filearr.com/deployment/unraid/#step-0-networking
Back up with pg_dump; the Meilisearch index is disposable but this database is not.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Database files. Use the DIRECT pool path (/mnt/cache/appdata/...) — Postgres through the /mnt/user FUSE layer risks locking/corruption (the classic Unraid database rule). Never on the array.

Config.Name: POSTGRES_PASSWORD
Config.Description: Database password — must match the DSNs on the filearr container

Config.Name: Port (optional)
Config.Description: Only map if you need external DB access (psql/pgAdmin from LAN). Leave empty otherwise.
